headline: Charter Communications drops bid to end merger conditions early
summary: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) said on Tuesday that Charter Communications Inc was abandoning its request to drop some merger conditions ahead of schedule as part of its 2016 tie-up with Time Warner Cable and Bright House Networks.
